description: I am looking for people to build an simple web app which takes data from the astronauts and gives them an simple ui and tell them whats wrong with their body
summary: We have developed a dashboard which shows your latest health data, along with graphs which shows the historic data of astronauts to shows downward/upwards trends in their health. This is important because our project uses no external apis/cloud services and fully works on an offline sqlite database
details: Our project tracks the users health data and stores them in an database, it uses python3 flask as backend and sqlite for its database, the frontend is the usual html,css,js combination. It is fully offline with no external api dependencies. We wanted to create an simple dashboard which would show the user their health information
